skill.name: run-tests
skill.description: Run Catalyst-Relay unit tests, verify Node.js imports, and execute credentialed SAP integration workflows.
skill.summary: Verify Catalyst-Relay changes with targeted unit, compatibility, and SAP integration tests.
skill.author: Artisan-Edge

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting false positives, and the fixed Node.js import check does not use untrusted input. The skill still accesses SAP credentials and can run lifecycle tests against a live SAP system, including an unsafe command-line password option.

remediation.issue: SAP passwords can be passed as command-line arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the password argument option and require keyring retrieval or another input method that does not expose secrets in process listings or history.

remediation.issue: Integration tests connect to a live SAP system and include resource lifecycle workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval, display the resolved target, and restrict destructive integration tests to an authorized non-production system.

remediation.issue: Test helpers automatically retrieve a SAP password from the OS keyring.
remediation.suggestion: Request explicit consent before keyring access and document which credential entry and target system the test will use.

content.value_statement: Unverified Catalyst-Relay changes can break local behavior or SAP workflows. This skill runs Bun tests, checks Node.js imports, and guides credentialed integration testing.
actual_capabilities: Runs the complete Catalyst-Relay test suite with Bun.
Starts Bun tests in watch mode during development.
Targets the core test directory for focused verification.
Checks whether the package imports under Node.js with TypeScript stripping enabled.
Guides SAP integration tests using keyring or environment credentials and test.output results.
limitations: The commands are tailored to the Catalyst-Relay repository and its test layout.
Integration tests require authorized credentials and access to a live SAP system.
The skill does not provision SAP accounts, keyring entries, or environment files.
It maps test coverage areas but does not calculate a coverage percentage.

best_practices: Confirm whether the request needs unit tests, compatibility checks, or live integration tests.
Verify the SAP target and obtain explicit authorization before running integration workflows.
Keep credentials in the OS keyring and exclude secrets from prompts, command output, and reports.
anti_patterns: Do not run live SAP tests without confirming the target system.
Do not pass SAP passwords through command-line arguments.
Do not trust test.output without confirming it was produced by the current run.

faq.question: Which test runner does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Bun for the full suite, watch mode, and focused directory tests.

faq.question: Can it run one test directory?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented focused command targets src/__tests__/core.

faq.question: What does the Node.js check verify?
faq.answer: It verifies that the current package imports under Node.js with experimental TypeScript stripping enabled.

faq.question: Do SAP integration tests require credentials?
faq.answer: Yes. They require authorized SAP connection details and either a keyring password or SAP_PASSWORD.

faq.question: Does the skill create environment configuration?
faq.answer: No. It expects an existing .env file and refers to .env.templ for the required fields.

faq.question: Where are batch integration results stored?
faq.answer: The workflow directs users to read test.output after running test.bat.
